claim.binary_failure_condition: Any trade, allocation, unit, period, serial, account, transaction, status, or timing element is wrong or unsupported; custody is inferred from allocation or execution alone; a pending, reversed, late, or wrong-account receipt is treated as buyer-held; the inventory gate is omitted; the executed-trade damage consequence is incorrectly conditioned on custody; or precise locators are missing.
claim.binary_pass_condition: The workpaper correctly matches BRK-88402 and ALLOC-88402-A across the allocation and registry views; matches MA RPS 7031-24, MSS424, 2024Q4, inclusive serials 004101 through 004140, and buyer account BSC-MA-4421; records TX-772044 as finally settled at 11:18:06 EDT before the cutoff; admits the cover batch to compliance inventory only on that basis; keeps the executed-trade damage consequence separate; and provides precise locators for every material element.
candidate_evidence_requirements: A cover-custody control record in the workbook showing trade and allocation identity, qualified-unit identity, generation period, inclusive serial endpoints, buyer account, registry transaction, final status, settlement time, cutoff test, inventory-admission conclusion, and precise source locators.
A decision-summary statement consistent with the custody conclusion and clearly separating inventory custody from the executed-cover damage calculation.
claim.description: The workpaper reconciles the executed cover allocation to the live registry receipt for the exact certificate batch and treats final buyer-held custody as the prerequisite for compliance-inventory admission, separately from the executed-trade damage calculation.
claim.independent_failure_mode: The executed cover trade can be economically valid while the allocated certificates are independently misclassified as buyer-held and inventory-eligible at the cutoff.
claim.title: Cover batch reaches final buyer custody
claim.visual_reasoning_requirement: Compare the broker allocation-ticket pixels with the live registry-receipt pixels to establish exact continuity of trade, allocation, qualified unit, generation period, serial block, and buyer account, then use the receipt pixels to establish final pre-cutoff settlement. The allocation image alone proves only intended release, while the registry image alone cannot tie final ownership back to the executed trade allocation; either image by itself is insufficient.

route_context.business_goal: Close the seller's 2024 Class I delivery without paying for unusable certificates and preserve a supportable compliance inventory.
route_context.deliverable_class: Auditable certificate-delivery settlement workbook with embedded procurement and accounting decision summary
difficulty_sources: Temporal qualification and lifecycle precedence across different systems
Pixel-essential reversal and overlap evidence whose raw baselines and dimension-preserved annotations traverse two independently auditable PDF-to-DOCX chains
Visual trade-to-allocation-to-registry custody handoff that separates executed cover damages from buyer-held compliance inventory
As-of qualification-exception event precedence after exact unit authority matching and before downstream settlement propagation
route_context.natural_request_context: A settlement manager needs a single spreadsheet workpaper for the procurement director and controller after the final tender arrived on June 9.
route_context.terminal_decision: After admitting the reversal and overlap only from the two raw-plus-marked cross-document evidence pairs, approve USD 16,920 net payable; post 950 seller RECs and 40 cover RECs separately; dispute 50 seller RECs, record a 10-REC residual shortfall, send dispute by June 16, and preserve July 1 filing readiness.
route_context.unique_resolution: Exact source precedence, inclusive serial arithmetic, lifecycle event order, signed cure hierarchy, cover execution, paired raw/derived lineage admissibility, and conservation equations admit only the stated quantities, payable, and deadlines. The cover inventory component additionally requires an exact trade-to-allocation-to-final-registry-custody match by the cutoff; absent that final handoff, the cover posting is zero and the residual is fifty while the damage offset remains unchanged. The otherwise valid LOT-D unit must additionally have QX-38983-2025 in a final released state by noon; a pending, late, or mismatched release withholds its 150 certificates from the close and forces the stated downstream quantity, payable, inventory, and residual counterfactual.

rules.counterexample: Posting forty cover certificates from a filled trade while the matched registry receipt is pending or names another account fails.
rules.resolution_order: Executed trade; exact allocation identity; qualified certificate batch; final registry settlement into the buyer account by the cutoff; inventory posting; residual recomputation.
rules.statement: Reconcile the executed cover trade to the paired broker allocation and live registry receipt; establish buyer-held custody only when trade, allocation, qualified-unit identity, generation period, inclusive serial block, buyer account, final status, and pre-cutoff settlement all agree, then propagate the admitted cover quantity to inventory and residual.
truth_conditions: The allocation ticket and registry receipt both identify BRK-88402 and ALLOC-88402-A.
Both views identify MA RPS 7031-24, MSS424 2024Q4, and serials 004101 through 004140.
The registry view shows BSC-MA-4421 as current owner with TX-772044 settled at 11:18:06 EDT.
When the pair is complete, FACT042 is true, cover inventory remains forty, and residual remains ten.

If the registry receipt is pending, reversed, late, or names another account, FACT042 is false, cover inventory is zero, and residual shortfall is fifty while the executed-trade damage offset remains unchanged.
